recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source edit is recommended for FHIR-16864 unless a future release reintroduces the misspelled ConceptMap identifier note.
issue_request: FHIR-16864 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core vocab change request for STU3 asking to correct the ConceptMap.identifier Note typo from "business identifer" to "business identifier" in the 2018-May ConceptMap definitions page.
initial_application: The Jira comment records svn revision 14734. Git history contains commit e185d0e837cb07e83c901a4d7ff333affcb42d21, "GF#16864 - fix typo", whose patch corrected the shared business identifier note template and related spelling mistakes from "identifer" to "identifier".
additional_context: ConceptMap is an active resource in source/fhir.ini, and the current active ConceptMap source is source/conceptmap/structuredefinition-ConceptMap.xml. Its ConceptMap.identifier element no longer carries the old Note text and does not contain the misspelling. Zulip and Confluence searches for FHIR-16864 and ConceptMap identifier typo terms found no conflicting community record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the typo is absent from current ConceptMap and shared definition source.
